Inside was a folded page, dry despite its long journey. The message gave a name, a date, and the position of a fishing boat that had vanished years earlier. On the back, in smaller writing, someone had added: We made it to shore. The keeper checked the old harbor records. The boat was listed as lost, with no survivors. He carried the page to the village, where the captain’s daughter still lived. She read it twice, then studied the handwriting. It was her father’s. The position marked an island beyond the usual routes. That evening, the keeper lit the lamp and watched a search vessel leave harbor.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。路灯照着空荡的街口，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下湿润的路面。便利店里亮着灯，店员整理货架；第一班公交车停在站台，司机等候乘客。远处的楼房只有几扇窗亮着。天色渐渐变浅，送货的货车驶入市场，摊主搬下成箱的蔬菜。晨风吹过树梢，街上的脚步声多了起来。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by asking the same kind of smaller problem.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding a smaller box inside, then opening that one.\n- You need a stopping point: when there are no more boxes, you stop."}
